hypotheses: Selected retained code is the code executed, no asynchronous/self-modifying interference; all stated accesses and return slots valid.
R67 follows a finite, non-faulting path and RET transfers to the expected R66 continuation 994f1a; GS-derived stores do not invalidate that premise.

The other calls that are actually reached return normally with balanced stack and the required ordinary nonvolatile-register preservation. This is a conditional ABI premise, not their recovered body contract.
Integer symbolic frame equalities use modulo64; ordinary address ordering/spans additionally require no relevant overflow/underflow and valid canonical mappings.
Recovery of original saved register CONTENTS requires saved bytes not to have been overwritten through GS/data/callee aliases; arithmetic slot identities alone do not establish this.

large_path: signed N>32. 46a3b0 receives RCX=&local30, RDX=N-floor(N/2)=ceil(N/2). Other formal values/content/ownership unknown. local30 and local38 have no established pre-initialization here.
small_path: signed N<=32 includes negative malformed values; RCX=begin, RDX=end to 998d50. No explicit BL argument setup; no small-path semantics recovered.
cleanup_path: After 998e10, a fresh unsigned QWORD[F+38]>0x155 selects 175da20 with fresh QWORD[F+30] in RCX. This does not prove allocation/free ownership.
return_value: Under required normal callee/stack premises, RAX is the last return from 998d50, 998e10 or 175da20 according to branch. No normalized Boolean/count/amount/completion result.
GS_alias: GS-derived BYTE writes and ordinary saved-stack writes may alias H/T, saved homes/helper temporary slots or return slots. Register identity does not imply pointee immutability. No alias exclusions assumed silently.
GS_conditional_loop: B=QWORD GS:[10], candidate=max_unsigned_underflow_clamped((S+8)-0x1040,0). If candidate>=B unsigned skip; otherwise L=candidate&fffffffffffff000 and write BYTE[B-1000*k]=0 for successive k until equality, modulo64. Finite no-wrap count (B-L)/1000 requires aligned B and valid normal stores; not guaranteed for arbitrary B.
R62_reachability: Simple AL==0 branch at984513->98472d bypasses 994f00; complex post993570 signed D<=0 branch98455b->9846e4 also bypasses. Original positive T/ALtrue/Dpositive are earlier gates only; subsequent unknown calls and aliases can change cells/headers.
remaining_unknowns: Contents, units, currency, recipient direction, sorting, conservation, complete output and final T/H remain unknown.
Runtime reachability, faults/exceptions, actual returned pointer/result, complete object layout, ownership, world lifetime and thread atomicity remain unproved.
R62 preceding and R66 later nonvolatile/stack assumptions are not replaced with recovered contracts for those unexamined calls.
